name: a_body_named_before_the_cut_is_not_measured
why: Z-C21.5, scheme S5, the case of the TODO entry «ingombro_corpo after a cut that renumbers». Until library 0.145.0 ingombro_corpo and proprieta_di_massa (CorpiScelti) and verifica_geometria_corpo read «C2» as the second body of a GetBodies2 made at that moment, and did not look at the state: IPartDoc~GetBodies2.html, Remarks, «May vary the order in which bodies are returned». A plan written looking at the state once -- two blocks, a cut, then a measure with the uid read BEFORE the cut -- measured a body that was no longer the one seen, with plausible numbers and success. combina_corpi and the overhang check (OperazioniSporgenze) were fixed in Z-C21.2 (CorpiDaUid and FirmaCombacia, see limit_combine_with_body_read_before_the_cut); since Z-C21.5 the three measures go through the same place (BodyAskedFor).
defect_caught: Steps 4, 6 and 8 carry the uid of the original block read BEFORE the cut («uid_dal_passo»: 3), with its signature: centre (0, 0, 5), box 100 x 50 x 10. The cut of step 3 shortens that block by 10 mm on the left, so no body of now has that signature any more: the uid names either the shortened block (centre moved by 5 mm) or the copy (centre at x = 60), depending on how GetBodies2 lists them. Either way it no longer names the body seen, and each operation must refuse. On the old library the three measures SUCCEEDED, on whichever body sat at that place.
_and_the_twin_is_in_the_same_file: Steps 5, 7 and 9 are the same operations without the uid read before: every body of now. Each differs from its refusal by its one argument, «corpo_uid», and succeeds: the refusal comes from the old name, not from bodies that cannot be measured.
_the_numbers: The part of limit_combine_with_body_read_before_the_cut. Block 100 x 50 x 10 centred: x from -50 to 50. Copy at dx = 60: x from 10 to 110. The through cut 15 x 70 centred at x = -47.5 removes the strip x from -50 to -40 of the block only: 5000 mm3. After it: 45000 + 50000 = 95000 mm3 in two bodies, and the box of the part goes from x = -40 to x = 110: 150 x 50 x 10.

steps._why_x_0: the front faces are two, one per body; GetClosestPointOn(0,0,0) puts the block's at x = 0 and the copy's at x = 10, as in limit_combine_with_body_read_before_the_cut
